proposed_sites.reason: Module path mcp.server.fastmcp is removed in v2 (moves to mcp.server.mcpserver), and the FastMCP class is renamed to MCPServer. Both the import path and the imported identifier must change to: from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer.
Constructs the server class using its old name FastMCP, which no longer exists in v2 under that name; must be changed to MCPServer(...) per the class rename.
